(mepacrine) Adverse Effects The most common adverse effects associated with mepacrine are dizziness, headache, and gastrointestinal disturbances such as nausea and vomiting. Reversible yellow discoloration of the skin, conjunctiva, and urine may occur during long-term use or after large doses; blue/black discoloration of the palate and dis- coloration of the nails have also been reported.
